description: This file defines an abstract class `Smarty_Resource` which serves as a base for implementing different resource types within the Smarty templating system. It includes methods for loading resource handlers, parsing resource names, populating source objects, and building unique resource identifiers, among others.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource
classes.description: An abstract class providing the interface and common functionality for resource plugins used by the Smarty templating system. It handles loading resource handlers, parsing resource names, and other resource management utilities.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns a resource handler object based on the resource type. It checks cache, registered resources, sysplugins, plugins directory, and stream wrappers sequentially before throwing an exception if the type is unknown.

methods.name: parseResourceName
methods.description: Parses a resource string to extract the resource type and name, defaulting to a provided resource type if no type prefix is found.

methods.name: getUniqueTemplateName
methods.description: Generates a unique resource name for a template, considering relative paths and resource types.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Initializes and loads a `Smarty_Template_Source` object for a given resource, either via an existing source object or parameters.
